title: Add security section to jmap-chat-wss-guide.md
description: jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md has a Security notes section. jmap-chat-wss-guide.md has none. Add a security section covering: (1) TLS requirement (WSS, not WS), (2) credential handling — do not retry with expired credentials, the 1008 code means re-authenticate; (3) authorization at delivery time (already mentioned in server fan-out, surface it in a security framing), (4) ephemeral event data exposure — typing and presence signals leak behavioral metadata, implement receiveTypingIndicators accordingly.
